heading: Aditya Birla Sun Life Pension Fund NPS Review: Returns, Portfolio & Fees (2026)
tldr: The National Pension System (NPS) is a voluntary, long-term retirement savings scheme regulated by the PFRDA.
Aditya Birla Sun Life Pension Fund is one of the fund managers for NPS, offering various asset class options.
Historically, Aditya Birla Sun Life Pension Fund has shown strong performance in government bonds over 3 to 7 years.
Its equity fund performance has generally been in the mid-table compared to its peers.
Understanding your chosen asset allocation and the associated fees is crucial for optimising your NPS returns.
caption:
Thinking about your retirement? 🤔 The National Pension System (NPS) can help you save for the future.
